hero.name: Faizur Rehman
hero.bio: I'm a Software Engineering student at the intersection of web development and cloud infrastructure — building applications that don't just work, but stay up. I don't just write front-end code. I deploy it, secure it, and automate how it ships, from Nginx configs to CI/CD pipelines on AWS. Fresh graduate mindset, production-minded habits.

paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineering undergraduate at Bahria University, Karachi, currently in my third year (2023–2027). My coursework spans data mining, software quality engineering, cloud computing, agile development, HCI and operating systems.

I started with front-end fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap — during a training program at Aptech, then moved into databases and desktop apps with C# and .NET. Since then I've pushed further into infrastructure: deploying real applications on AWS, configuring Nginx from scratch, and automating deployments with CI/CD.
I care about software that's practical and sellable, not just an assignment. Outside of code, I do photography and enjoy the outdoors.

experience.title: Web Development Trainee
experience.description: Completed an intensive full-stack web development training program — from responsive front ends to relational databases and desktop applications.

projects.title: AWS & Nginx Web Infrastructure
projects.subtitle: Scalable web infrastructure deployment on AWS EC2 & S3
projects.description: Deployed and configured a production-style Nginx web server on AWS EC2, with S3 for static asset hosting, IAM/Security Groups for least-privilege access, and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline that auto-deploys on every push.
